response_space: logFC against ONE vehicle per cell line (the pooled construction): logfc = log1p(treated pseudobulk) - log1p(pooled vehicle pseudobulk).
vehicle_construction_detail: One shared vehicle per cell line, estimated as the mean of that line's per-pair control pseudobulks from the author's frozen split (release_asoc/split/sciplex_test_control_counts.npy).
row_alignment: positional; row i of every matrix matches row i of pair_order.csv. The meta file is never joined by key.
feature_names: none supplied; the 3000 training-only HVGs in the release's split/gene_order.csv order (index 0..2999)
notes: This is the space of the paper's headline numbers. The prediction matrix is the per-pair loss-only matrix converted with logfc_pooled = logfc_perpair + log1p(ctrl_pair) - log1p(ctrl_line).
